_comment: 🎛️ Test-only references of the 🎛️dashboard owner. The dashboard ships no reference-able format: its command tree is a projection of this repository's own nx manifests, its own taxonomy segment rule and its own repo domain, so the only entry here is a recorded no-oracle decision.

noOracleDecisions.rationale: What the dashboard offers is derived from this repository alone: which nx targets exist, which taxonomy segments are noise, which verbs sort first, which tickets and goals `.🧬semio/🦑️repo` carries, and which repo-domain operations the Rust crates answer in process. No task runner, no launcher and no third-party menu builder projects that tree, so there is nothing to compare against, and reaching the real repository would put a developer's own `.🧬semio` and every nx manifest of the monorepo inside a test. Confidence comes from a frozen workspace vector materialised into the case's work directory, so the whole projection — every wizard path, every process leaf and every repo leaf with both its action key and its Go argv — is pinned rather than sampled, and from the metamorphic law that the order the workspace files were written in does not reach the projection. A differential half arrives when a second implementation of the discovery walk exists; until then this is conformance against those vectors, stated here rather than dressed up as differential evidence. This decision covers no runtime mutation capability: the scenarios only read the materialised workspace copy.
